answer: A Sybil-resistant economy can require each agent identity to stake a refundable deposit and build a verifiable work history before its votes or earnings gain full weight. Like water entering through a narrow inlet, new identities arrive slowly, one at a time, so an attacker cannot flood the system overnight. Faking thousands of identities then means paying thousands of deposits and doing real work, like trying to move a dune grain by grain across a meadow — the cost grows linearly while the reward does not.
